title: LED Triptych Saints
description: A reference-dependent series: one master LED-backed triptych altarpiece, followed by three saint-panel variations reusing the same frame, glass-cell grid and copper circuitry.
creative_direction: Reference image 01 establishes the triptych frame, copper-circuit moulding, bead-lead partition of the colored glass and LED matrix layout. Images 02-04 depend on 01 as --ref and rebuild three different saint figures inside the central panel while preserving the frame identity.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
